text:
本周市场整体情绪是偏积极的，而且这种积极情绪持续了整周，但力度不算特别强。市场波动性（VIX（衡量市场恐慌情绪，越高越慌），衡量市场恐慌程度的指标，越高越慌）处于中等水平，说明大家没有特别恐慌。债券收益率曲线（10Y-2Y，反映了长期和短期借钱的利率差，通常长期利率高于短期代表经济预期较好）是正斜率但比较平，意味着经济预期温和。同时，信用利差（Baa-10Y，衡量公司借钱比政府借钱多付多少利息，越低说明大家觉得公司还钱风险越小）偏低，表明市场对公司还钱能力比较有信心，整体融资环境比较宽松。值得关注的是，个股之间的联动性（个股共动，衡量股票走势是否一致，越高越一致）比较低，说明很多股票走势是独立的，不是大家一起涨或一起跌。本周科技和工业板块表现突出，但也有科技和半导体板块出现较大跌幅。
（这是数据读数不是预测，会错，过去不代表未来）
text_en:
This week, market sentiment was generally positive and remained so throughout the week, though not exceptionally strong. Market volatility (VIX, a measure of market fear, the higher it is, the more fearful people are) was at a moderate level, indicating no extreme panic. The bond yield curve (10Y-2Y, reflecting the difference between long-term and short-term borrowing rates; typically, higher long-term rates than short-term rates suggest better economic expectations) was positively sloped but quite flat, meaning economic expectations are mild. Meanwhile, credit spreads (Baa-10Y, measuring how much more interest companies pay to borrow money compared to the government; lower spreads suggest people believe companies have a lower risk of not repaying) were low, showing the market is confident in companies' ability to repay their debts, and the overall financing environment is relatively loose. It is worth noting that the correlation between individual stocks (stock co-movement, measuring how much stock movements are in sync; the higher it is, the more in sync they are) was low, indicating that many stocks moved independently, rather than rising or falling together. The technology and industrial sectors performed well this week, but some technology and semiconductor stocks also experienced significant declines.
(These are data readings, not predictions, and can be wrong. The past does not represent the future.)
caveat: LLM 据本周真实算出因子生成的大白话回顾；喂真数据防瞎编，但仍可能误读。非预测、非荐股、会错，过去≠未来。每周 append 到 llm_weekly_log 公开计分。
